admitted_and_binding.note: BINDING is `fails_only` -- names failing ONLY that rule, i.e. what relaxing it alone would buy. NOT the first-fired reason: the chain short-circuits, so `excluded_by_reason` names the earliest rule a name failed.

THE_FINDING.headline: Decision B.1 4a, implemented literally, would EMPTY hack6 and halve hack3.
THE_FINDING.mechanism: The four band-return constants were not only an exclusion rule -- they were the SOURCE of `exp_return` for every name they covered. Take them away and `murat_rule.score` falls back to `(2*p_up - 1) * claimed_abs_move` off the 152-name panel, whose UNCONDITIONAL base rate is p_up = 0.4615 (the rule-firing cell is 0.5082). Negative for everything the rule does not fire on.
THE_FINDING.measured: 799 of 810 candidates fail the coherence floor `exp_return not positive` under hygiene-only, versus 35 of 806 under the live setting.
THE_FINDING.consequence: the long-book coherence floor becomes the SOLE gate: hack6 0 names, hack3 5, hack4 5.
THE_FINDING.hygiene_itself_is_not_the_cause: hygiene excluded 33 of 810 candidates and its `fails_only` is ZERO in all three books -- not one name was admitted or refused because of hygiene alone.
what_is_needed_from_Murat: (i) what feeds `exp_return` once the band constants are gone -- the panel base rate (which empties the books), the learner, or a flat prior; OR
(ii) whether the coherence floor still applies when `exp_return` is a transferred 152-name base rate rather than a measured band.
THE_FINDING.status: the flag exists, is OFF by default, the live fleet is byte-identical without it, and both modes are exercised by the suite. DO NOT set AAT_BAND_MODE=hygiene_only on a live service until (i) or (ii) is answered.

what_the_flag_changes.1_admits: UPSIDE_IMPLAUSIBLE_AT (ratio >= 4.0) stops BARRING candidacy and becomes a reported indicator
what_the_flag_changes.2_excludes: the hard price floor rises $1 -> $2, the condition every EXP-RETURN-XS-1 cell was measured under
what_the_flag_changes.3_excludes: a target window whose high/low exceeds 5x is UNREADABLE and is barred -- the split / share-basis defect the toxic band was made of, named as a data defect instead of priced as a forecast
what_the_flag_changes.kept_as_indicator: `upside_band` travels on every scored row in BOTH modes -- a guide a reader and a model can see, and a gate in neither once the flag is on

risk_budget_usd.basis: per-name notional fraction x $100,000 frozen genesis equity x the profile stop
